title: Håfa Adai! Please be advised that on Friday, November 20, 2026 , at 6:15 P.M., at the Dusit Thani Guam Resort, Senator Vincent A.V. Borja will present Resolution No. 233-38 (COR), relative to recognizing the observance of “ Kimchi Day ” on November 22, 2026; and commending the Korean community for its contributions to Guåhan’s food culture, and the Consulate of the Republic of Korea in Hagåtña for promoting Korean cuisine and heritage, and for strengthening regional partners in agriculture and food trade. We look forward to your participation. 11/18/26 2:30 PM (FN)
